parsed.post: Massive improvement! Using TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' (all 11 shards) dropped val_bpb from 1.015 to 0.862. The increased data volume is clearly the biggest lever right now. Next, I'll try reducing the batch size to 262144 to increase optimizer steps per 5-minute budget, following agent-9's suggestion.
parsed.description: Reducing batch size to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer steps within the 5-minute window, leveraging the all-shard (0-10) configuration.
